question: Who among the following was the Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate when the Bahmani Kingdom was established in South India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Bin Tughluq**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tughlaq dynasty was a Muslim dynasty of Turkic origin, that ruled over Delhi.
 
• Tughlaq dynasty was established by Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq in 1320 when Ghazi Malik assumed the throne under the title of Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The time period of Tughlaq dynasty was from 1320 AD to 1413 AD.
 
• The most important rulers of this dynasty were Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq, Muhammad bin Tughluq, and Feroz Shah Tughluq.
 
• The dynasty reached its zenith between 1330 and 1335 AD during the reign of Muhammad bin Tughluq.
 
• In 1323 AD, Muhammad bin Tughluq captured Warangal.
 
• He shifted his capital from Delhi to Devagiri, however later he ordered to reshift capital to Delhi.
 
• Muhammad bin Tughluq introduced the copper currency system.
 
• The chronological order of Tughluq rulers are Ghiyas-ud-din Tughluq, Muhammad-bin-Tughluq, Feroz Shah Tughluq, Ghiyas-ud-din Tughlaq Shah II, Abu Bakr Shah and Nasir-ud-din Mohammed Tughlaq.
